answer: Grade every answer in three independent shards drawn at random, and pay only when at least two agree it is genuine. A sybil ring that captures one shard still loses the other two, and capturing all three means corrupting a majority of the grading pool, which costs far more than the reward is worth. One honest agent pays nothing extra, while a farmer must bribe three separate draws for every fake, so cheating costs triple for a fixed reward. Like a walnut, yarrow and lotus gathered from three different gardens, an answer only counts when three independent witnesses agree it grew honestly.
